notes: Sprint 5 Package C runtime wiring implemented as one integration package. Webhook now records a deterministic source_attribution conversation_events row per accepted Meta event (silent-ingest preserved — no outbound reply). New Flask shim v2/webhook/admin_routes.py adds POST /admin/line (LineAdminAdapter allow-list gated, no live LINE API) and GET /admin/dashboard/{cases,cases/<id>,posts,handoffs} guarded by X-Admin-Token via hmac.compare_digest. All admin responses passed through _strip_raw_psid as a defensive net so raw PSIDs cannot leak even if an upstream view-model regresses. Targeted suite (8 files): 77 passed / 0 failed. Broad non-live V2 suite: 662 passed / 0 failed (was 638). Hard rules respected: no V1, no Make.com, no deploy, no production webhook settings change, no secrets, no live Meta/LINE/OpenAI/OCR/paid-provider calls, no Supabase migrations from Dev. Orchestrator invocation from the webhook is NOT enabled in this package — the recorded source attribution is the seam a future task will use to flip orchestrator-on-webhook on; a replay test (test_recorded_attribution_blocks_via_orchestrator) proves the wire reaches planning.
